title: Prove sharp fixed BIT repairs and a two-code hybrid controller
body:
## Summary

Prove a sharp repair count for the inherited BIT bank recipe: with `2B` arbitrary public banks, the fixed word needs exactly `2B+1` allowed repair calls for odd `B` and `2B−1` for even `B`. Explicit rank-one idempotent decompositions attain the bound, including any finite number of restored dirty spectators.

For a separate mixed coded/clean local alphabet on the same recipe, move the correction to the terminal cut and reduce six source-code applications to two. A written all-B identity and a restricted determinant lower bound match that count. At the assigned 1,499-ADD code size this saves 5,996 scalar ADDs. See `research/bit-fixed-controller-repairs/README.md` and its two proof notes.

## Scope and limits

The sharp repair theorem fixes every original local call, bridge and exchange; its added calls are scalar-conjugated single-bank applications of one common nonidentity involution. It is not an unrestricted caller lower bound. The two-code optimum separately fixes the coded first pair and the single-bank generator alphabet.

The hybrid's two 111-port normalization sweeps remain, and its conditional comparison with the all-clean word still loses 102 rank units. The actual early-promotion route witness rejects one free native-code admission. Logical algebra does not supply mixed helper ownership, physical frames, source access or rounding. No selected-record change or new kappa is claimed.

## Test plan

- [x] CPython 3.12 committed-byte/source-history preflight and all four registered commands.
- [x] Read-only Git-free export replay with unchanged package inputs.
- [x] Separate mathematical and verification reviews, with findings resolved.
- [x] [Automatic hosted package CI](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39424497085) passed on `b512fd71e9eb5711d24abaa35978660eeb87f363`.

The package replays three complete historical receipts and two independent implementations. Checks include the all-B formula and attaining-repair fixtures, arbitrary dirty spectator instantiations, ordered free-group-ring inverse/dual identities, an explicit binary VALUE fiber witness and normal/optimized acceptance controls. The universal results are written proofs; finite fixtures and AI review are not formal-kernel proofs.

## Sources and credit

Retains the DreamingOfClouds/eumemic/Zhihao Chen/chafreaky bank-recipe lineage and source notices, Ali Romman's R438/source-code ancestry, and Sagar Thakrar's transport/rehosting. #3645 supplies the coded local interface; #4039 supplies distinct FULL-target/seeded-caller context and is not republished. #4185 supplies the separate returned-owner comparison. Exact source pins and differing related alphabets are recorded in the package manifests.

Original findings, new all-parameter proofs and two-code construction, independent checking contexts and publication were prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0.
